ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISBLANK(Account.TMs_to_Hire_by_M3__c), ISBLANK(Account.TMs_to_Hire_by_M6__c) ) && ISCHANGED(StageName) && ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Verbal Commit") && OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Initial_Opportunity", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Expansion_Upsell" ) && OR( ISPICKVAL(Type,"New Business"), CONTAINS(Owner.UserRole.Name," AE") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in [TMs to Hire by M3] and [TMs to Hire by M6] on the account before changing this opportunity's Stage.
